name: SparkAxes
description: Represents the settings for the horizontal and vertical axes of a group of sparklines.
remarks: Use the Axes property of a SparklineGroup object to return the SparkAxes object for that group of sparklines.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SparklineGroup object for the specified SparkAxes object. Read-only.

properties.name: Vertical
properties.description: Returns the SparkVerticalAxis object for the specified SparkAxes object. Read-only.

properties.name: Horizontal
properties.description: Returns the SparkHorizontalAxis object for the specified SparkAxes object. Read-only.
